[Story]
The boss lady, Li Ting, firmly believes that offline stores are the stable business. The young clerk, Xiao Chen, sets up an online store using the internet, he hopes to convince Li Ting to try e-commerce.

[Question]
How does Xiao Chen convince Li Ting?

[Candidate Answers]
A. He thinks e-commerce is an additional sales channel, it does not affect the offline business, but is a supplement.
B. Chen can suggest that the cardboard packaging of e-commerce promotes environmental protection concepts, attracting consumers with strong environmental awareness.
C. Through e-commerce, he gets user feedback more directly to improve products or services.
D. He provides relevant e-commerce training and guidance, ensuring Li Ting easily gets the hang of it.
